test_title: PYST 19: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 18 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Dipesh will send Rakesh away to college for certain reasons.

options.text: Rakesh will have to be sent away to college for certain reasons by Dipesh.
Rakesh will be sent away to college for certain reasons by Dipesh.
Rakesh would have been sent away to college for certain reasons by Dipesh.
Rakesh would be sent away to college for certain reasons by Dipesh.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Dipesh will send Rakesh away to college for certain reasons."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "Rakesh" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "will send" to "will be sent" (future simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "Dipesh."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Rakesh will be sent away to college for certain reasons by Dipesh."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Rakesh will have to be sent away to college for certain reasons by Dipesh." – Incorrect tense (future necessity passive).
 
• **Option 3:** "Rakesh would have been sent away to college for certain reasons by Dipesh." – Incorrect tense (past conditional passive).
 
• **Option 4:** "Rakesh would be sent away to college for certain reasons by Dipesh." – Incorrect tense (conditional passive).
